narrative: The market is currently in a risk-off regime as the S&P 500 enters correction territory, down 10% from its peak. Investors are aggressively de-risking from AI-driven tech stocks amid regulatory scrutiny of Nvidia and concerns over the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending. Simultaneously, the US 10-year yield holding above 5% is elevating capital costs, pressuring equity valuations. While recession concerns weigh on sentiment, the US Dollar is showing significant strength. The broader market sell-off is occurring despite isolated pockets of strength like the Anthropic IPO.

Nasdaq.why: The index is facing a significant de-risking event as tech stocks are pummeled by regulatory concerns and high capital costs.

S&P 500.why: The index has officially entered correction territory, down 10% from record highs with broad-based selling across constituents.

Gold.why: Gold is trading lower, down 2.65% to $3,530 per ounce, as investors shift toward bonds and the USD.

Oil.why: WTI and Brent crude are seeing modest gains despite the broader market downturn.

priced_in: A significant de-risking event across equity markets
Reduced probability of a December Fed interest rate hike
Expectations for two additional interest rate hikes
Heightened sensitivity regarding the sustainability of corporate AI capex
debates: Sustainability of the AI-driven growth narrative versus concerns over infrastructure funding and regulatory restrictions
Divergence between the broader market sell-off and robust institutional demand for specific AI-related IPOs like Anthropic
watch_next: Ongoing SEC probe into Nvidia's accounting practices

Developments in US-China AI-related export controls
